scenes.setting: Breakfast and pipe smoke: Stanton reasons that a Devil who cannot divine must have investigated them in person, leaving traces everywhere — 'wherever he steps, whatever he touches… will serve as a silent witness against him' — and names the Sealed Artifact being activated against him, 1-42, a blood-stained silver armor that once emptied a city

Quiet talk in the repaired activity room, Kaslana pegged as Arbiter-pathway and left unasked; then last wishes traded like death flags — a tombstone reading 'She had a great mother', remains sent to Lenburg, and Klein's plea to be buried intact — until Ikanser arrives: 'There's a clue to the Desire Apostle!'
scenes.text_anchor: “There’s a clue to the Desire Apostle!”
